thread:
sasha chen: quick design review request — in the private setup wizard networking step i noticed two issues during the usability run: 1) our CIDR helper text is confusing for dual-stack clusters (we show only IPv4 examples), and 2) the probe results panel traps keyboard focus when you expand a probe detail and then click "Run all probes". can we sync on copy + small a11y fixes?
maia nguyen: thanks for flagging. for CIDR helper text i suggest a short inline hint: "Supported formats: IPv4 (10.0.0.0/16) and IPv6 (fd00::/8). If you're unsure, pick IPv4." keeps it simple and avoids long explainer. also propose moving the examples into a tooltip so they don't clutter the form.
jamal taylor: the focus trap sounds like an aria issue — when the panel opens we set focus to the heading but don't restore it after the action. solution: store the previously-focused element and call .focus() after probe run completes. also add aria-live polite on the probe status so screenreaders get updates without focus changes.
andrew liu: for the probe details collapse behavior, can we make the expanded drawer non-modal (i.e., not trap focus) and add a keyboard shortcut to close (Esc)? Example snippet for restoring focus: 

```
const prev = document.activeElement;
await runAllProbes();
if (prev && typeof prev.focus === 'function') prev.focus();
```

also +1 to a tooltip for examples.
sasha chen: nice — maia, can you propose the tooltip microcopy? also jamal, do we need a live region for incremental probe progress or just final status?
maia nguyen: draft tooltip: "Examples: IPv4 — 10.0.0.0/16; IPv6 — fd00::/8. If your infra uses both, enter the CIDR for the control plane." kept it short. for the inline helper text I'd rather: "Enter a network in CIDR notation. Examples: 10.0.0.0/16 (IPv4), fd00::/8 (IPv6)."
jamal taylor: incremental updates are helpful — users watch probe logs. add an aria-live region for streaming probe messages (aria-live="polite"), and then a separate assertive toast on final success/failure. that balances noise vs info.
design-bot: screenshot uploaded: https://files.redwood.ai/ux/onprem-probe-trap-202603.png :camera_with_flash: (shows focus stuck inside drawer)
andrew liu: small layout note — move the help link from the very bottom of the wizard step into the field label line (right-aligned) so keyboard users can tab to it immediately. reduces discoverability friction.
maia nguyen: microcopy tweak proposal for final status: "Connectivity check complete — 3/4 checks passed. Click for details or follow the suggested repairs." avoids scary language and gives clear CTA.
sasha chen: plan: maia will update the UI copy + tooltip, jamal will add aria-live and restore-focus patch, and andrew will adjust the help link placement + escape key handler. i'll file a tiny follow-up PR to tweak the e2e test for keyboard flows. target: ship before next patch release. thanks all :thumbsup:
